metrics.notes: Hsueh et al. ISB 2009 tumble net at contact: elbow angle 139° (dab 142°); tolerance band 130–150 around tumble. MediaPipe 2D elbow angle is a proxy of lab joint angle.

citations.title: Hsueh, Tsai, Pan, Chang. Biomechanical analysis of badminton tumble net shot (ISB 2009)
citations.extracted: Elite collegiate Taiwanese males (n=8), tumble net shot at contact: Elbow angle 139° (dab 142°) → range 130–150.
